Package org.apache.nutch.tools

Class CommonCrawlFormatJackson

java.lang.Object
org.apache.nutch.tools.AbstractCommonCrawlFormat
org.apache.nutch.tools.CommonCrawlFormatJackson
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, CommonCrawlFormat
public class CommonCrawlFormatJackson extends AbstractCommonCrawlFormat
This class provides methods to map crawled data on JSON using Jackson Streaming APIs.
